name: Spooder-Kid: Shattered World
overview: Its been a few months since Spooder-Kid has defeated the Bubbler. Its winter time. The boys are well adjusted to their new lives. But when a new villain who goes by the name of Octavius creates a dangerous machine to make infinite energy and finish what the Bubbler started , Spooder-Kid intervenes. Will he save his town from this new unwanted threat?
